title: Implement immutable GPU profile shadow-states and TF IAM templater for safe migration
author: Nora Singh
description:
Motivation: Private deployments require safe, low-risk migration paths when we change how GPU node pools and their TF state are managed. Recent incidents showed that in-place state edits and IAM role rotations during upgrades can cause transient failures and operator overhead. This PR implements two complementary safety mechanisms: (1) immutable GPU profile shadow-states (a copy-on-write TF state anchoring pattern) to allow safe rollout and quick rollback without mutating the original state, and (2) an IAM templater that centralizes role generation and rotation hooks so baked-in policies remain reproducible across environments.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces terraform/modules/tfstate_anchor: a small module that creates a shadow backend pointer and state anchors (metadata S3 object + locking marker) so we can stage changes against a shadow state before switching traffic.
- Adds terraform/modules/gpu_profile_v2 (immutable): a GPU profile module that writes an immutable profile manifest into the shadow state and provisions nodepool resources only when 'anchor_switch' is flipped. Profiles are never mutated in-place; changes create a new profile version.
- Adds tools/iam-templater: a lightweight templater script (Go) that renders consistent IAM role documents from a declarative YAML template and emits rotation hooks for vault/KMS integration.
- Migration helper: tooling/terraform-plan-diff.sh and docs/migration/anchor-guides.md that outline the step-by-step migration (create shadow, apply to shadow, smoke-test, switch anchors, and garbage-collect old states).
- Adds lifecycle and precondition checks across modules to fail fast when switching anchors without smoke test sign-off.

Why this approach:
- Minimizes blast radius for state migrations by keeping the existing state intact until a deliberate anchor switch.
- Enables deterministic IAM role reprovisioning across tenants via the templater, which reduces drift that previously caused privilege escalations during upgrades.
- Provides clear rollback hooks: revert anchor pointer and destroy shadow resources if the rollout fails.

Merge note: Squash-merged after CI green. Post-merge run (canary) applied the shadow state for two internal tenants; operator runbook followed and rollback path was exercised successfully in one tenant due to a node pool quota error. The rollback executed cleanly and original state remained untouched.

Operator guidance (short):
1) create anchor with `tf apply -var=anchor_name=anchor-20251115 -target=module.tfstate_anchor` against the shadow backend
2) deploy new GPU profile into shadow via `terraform workspace select shadow && tf apply`
3) run CI smoke tests (ci/e2e/anchor-smoke-test.yaml) against the shadow cluster
4) when green, `tf state set-anchor --switch anchor-20251115` (operator tool included in tools/)
5) monitor for 30m; if problems, run `tools/anchor-rollback.sh` to point back to previous anchor and destroy shadow resources

Release notes: "Add TF state anchoring and immutable GPU profile module to enable safe migration/rollback for private deployments. Includes IAM templater for reproducible role materialization and operator runbook."
